For a fruit orchard near Nagpur, I’d compare these on repeat testing cost + nutrient coverage + actionable advice:

Option	Cost	What you get	Long-term value
Seed Testing Laboratory	Low; confirm current rate	Local government testing	Good for routine annual checks
ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey & Land Use Planning	Quote required	Research-grade soil assessment	Good for baseline/complex soil issues
Sankalp Civil Consultants	~₹2,000–6,000/sample reported	Fertility/organic-matter testing	Useful if you want private convenience

Nagpur APMC also offers farmer soil testing at ₹30/sample, making it particularly inexpensive for recurring monitoring. 
APMC Nagpur

For fruit trees, ensure the package covers pH, EC, organic carbon, N-P-K, Zn, Fe, Mn, Cu and ideally B, rather than only NPK. ICAR-CCRI specifically lists these parameters for its Nagpur soil testing service.
